cards_step_terms.name: cards_step_terms
cards_step_terms.value: ("cards"."step" IS NULL) = ("cards"."state"::text = 'review') AND ("cards"."step" IS NULL OR "cards"."step" >= 0)

cards_review_terms.name: cards_review_terms
cards_review_terms.value: num_nulls("cards"."stability", "cards"."difficulty", "cards"."last_review_at", "cards"."last_rating") IN (0, 4) AND ("cards"."last_review_at" IS NOT NULL OR "cards"."state"::text = 'learning')

cards_memory_bounds.name: cards_memory_bounds
cards_memory_bounds.value: ("cards"."stability" IS NULL OR "cards"."stability" > 0) AND ("cards"."difficulty" IS NULL OR "cards"."difficulty" BETWEEN 1 AND 10)

holdout_checks_kind_terms.name: holdout_checks_kind_terms
holdout_checks_kind_terms.value: ("holdout_checks"."kind" = 'begun' AND "holdout_checks"."begun_at" IS NOT NULL AND "holdout_checks"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "holdout_checks"."held_out_score" IS NULL AND "holdout_checks"."practised_score" IS NULL) OR ("holdout_checks"."kind" = 'taken' AND "holdout_checks"."begun_at" IS NOT NULL AND "holdout_checks"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "holdout_checks"."held_out_score" IS NOT NULL AND "holdout_checks"."practised_score" IS NOT NULL AND "holdout_checks"."held_out_score" >= 0 AND "holdout_checks"."practised_score" >= 0 AND "holdout_checks"."begun_at" <= "holdout_checks"."closed_at") OR ("holdout_checks"."kind" = 'skipped' AND "holdout_checks"."begun_at" IS NULL AND "holdout_checks"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "holdout_checks"."held_out_score" IS NULL AND "holdout_checks"."practised_score" IS NULL)

review_log_elapsed_days_terms.name: review_log_elapsed_days_terms
review_log_elapsed_days_terms.value: ("review_log"."elapsed_days" IS NULL) = ("review_log"."before_last_review_at" IS NULL) AND ("review_log"."elapsed_days" IS NULL OR "review_log"."elapsed_days" >= 0)

town_events_building_terms.name: town_events_building_terms
town_events_building_terms.value: CASE WHEN "town_events"."kind"::text IN ('building_work_finished', 'building_work_stopped') THEN "town_events"."building" IS NOT NULL AND "town_events"."level" IS NOT NULL AND "town_events"."level" >= 1 ELSE "town_events"."building" IS NULL AND "town_events"."level" IS NULL END

town_jobs_clean_up_terms.name: town_jobs_clean_up_terms
town_jobs_clean_up_terms.value: ("town_jobs"."waste_size" IS NULL AND "town_jobs"."waste" IS NULL AND "town_jobs"."strength" IS NULL AND NOT "town_jobs"."has_arrived" AND "town_jobs"."hours" >= 1) OR ("town_jobs"."waste_size" IS NOT NULL AND "town_jobs"."waste" IS NOT NULL AND "town_jobs"."strength" IS NOT NULL AND "town_jobs"."waste_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "town_jobs"."waste" >= 0 AND "town_jobs"."strength" >= 1 AND "town_jobs"."hours" = 0 AND NOT ("town_jobs"."has_arrived" AND "town_jobs"."called_back_at" IS NOT NULL))

towns_work_slot_terms.name: towns_work_slot_terms
towns_work_slot_terms.value: num_nonnulls("towns"."work_building", "towns"."work_level", "towns"."work_started_at", "towns"."work_finishes_at", "towns"."work_cost_money", "towns"."work_cost_food", "towns"."work_cost_power", "towns"."work_cost_material") = 0 OR (num_nonnulls("towns"."work_building", "towns"."work_level", "towns"."work_started_at", "towns"."work_finishes_at", "towns"."work_cost_money", "towns"."work_cost_food", "towns"."work_cost_power", "towns"."work_cost_material") = 8 AND "towns"."work_level" >= 1 AND "towns"."work_started_at" <= "towns"."work_finishes_at" AND "towns"."work_cost_money" >= 0 AND "towns"."work_cost_money" = trunc("towns"."work_cost_money") AND "towns"."work_cost_food" >= 0 AND "towns"."work_cost_food" = trunc("towns"."work_cost_food") AND "towns"."work_cost_power" >= 0 AND "towns"."work_cost_power" = trunc("towns"."work_cost_power") AND "towns"."work_cost_material" >= 0 AND "towns"."work_cost_material" = trunc("towns"."work_cost_material"))
